scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace shared && concurrently --kill-others --success first --names shared,frontend,backend "npm run dev --workspace shared" "npm run dev:app --workspace frontend" "npm run dev:app --workspace backend"
scripts.package:dev: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run package:dev --workspace frontend
scripts.package:prod: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run package:prod --workspace frontend
